title: Fixed JSON settings footer and remove image export

request.text: Vậy cho cụm 2 button này xuống bên dưới, fixed position. Bỏ tính năng export PNG đi, ko cần thiết

decision: Reuse the native settingsTransfer UI and codec in the native Panel footer via a presentation-only section projection. Remove image-export capability and export-only passes.
result: Fixed native settings footer and JSON-only export deployed to the existing node-animation project at https://nodeanimation.vercel.app/. Live scrolling confirms fixed buttons and no Image Export section.
checks: Three selected product unit checks passed
Production JSON/footer browser scenario passed with signed evidence reporter
Local and Vercel production builds passed
Live site reopened and footer scrolled; screenshot retained
risks: Footer placement is an app-owned projection because the runtime settingsTransfer schema has no placement flag.

The test:feature wrapper twice exceeded its protected 20000ms load-feature-plan deadline; no protected feature receipt is claimed. Direct production browser behavior and signed evidence checks passed.
